page.overview:
Who is Aquilops?

Aquilops is first seen in Jurassic World: Rebirth. Being one of the smaller herbivores in the franchise, it very much resembles its close relative, Microceratus. However, Aquilops possesses a different color scheme, being orange with black stripes, and also has two horns; a nasal horn and a horn on the front of its beak. While no other Aquilops are seen in the franchise aside from Dolores, in Jurassic World: The Game, the Aquilops possess individual color schemes like jade-green with three different shades and they possess quills in back of their tails, these individuals are male[Citation needed].

Dolores, seen with a plant in her mouth, was seen standing on her hind legs, intently watching a young human girl. Her curious demeanor shifted to fright when the girl's older sister scared her away. However, the dinosaur soon returned, making snorting sounds as it cautiously approached the younger girl once more, eventually finding comfort and sleeping on her back.

Aquilops was cloned at a secret research facility on Ile Saint-Hubert by InGen, sometime prior to the island's evacuation in 2010 caused by the Distortus Rex, though the reason for this species was abandoned are unknown. Psittacosaurus was mentioned as possibly being added in the genetic components of Aquilops during their hybridization program, for more genetic diversity.

In 2027, Isabella Delgado, who was shipwrecked on the island alongside her family, was searching for a stick to help brush aside plants, when an Aquilops darts out of a fern bush, and watches her as it eats. Isabella's older sister, Teresa, frightens off the ceratopsian, causing it to run back into the jungle. That night, the Aquilops returned, and while her dad and sister were sleeping, and Xavier was by the river, she feeds it some candy. After starting to trust her more, the dinosaur soon falls asleep on her bag.
